caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a rectangular backrest and a rectangular seat, both of which are upholstered. The upholstery displays a detailed pattern with multiple colors, including dark green, blue, red, yellow, and beige, forming a tapestry-like design. The legs and support structure of the chair are crafted from wood and feature ornate, turned detailing on all the vertical and horizontal supports. The wood appears dark brown, contrasting with the colorful fabric. The chair is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or features.
title: American Chair with Turkey Work
